jurisdiction.venue: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) & Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT)

docket_number: SEBI Interim Order July 2025 / SAT Order Reserved Oct. 21, 2026
headline: Wall Street’s Quietest Quant Giants Discover Mumbai’s Options Pit Has a Cover Charge
deck: India’s securities regulator impounded ₹4,843.57 crore ($553 million) in escrow from four Jane Street trading affiliates over alleged Bank Nifty expiry-day manipulation; an appellate tribunal reserved judgment in October.
byline: By The Financial Crimes Mumbai Bureau

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Civil regulatory dispute: ₹4,843.57 Cr (~$553M–$565M) deposited in escrow while SAT weighs Jane Street affiliates’ appeal.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Rigging a local card table for ₹1.5 lakh ($1,800)
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Immediate police booking rather than a 15-month appellate tribunal briefing
